Bihar STET Online Form 2026 – Extend – Full Details

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released a Notification for the Bihar State Teacher Eligibility STET Examination 2026 on the official website of the BSEB. Applications for the Bihar STET Online Form 2026 has Started from 17 August 2026 & Candidate can apply until 22 September 2026 (Extended). Candidates can Check full details of Bihar STET Online Form 2026 which given below.

Important Dates

  • Paper / Class : Eligibility

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete registration with your basic details, mobile number, and email.
  3. Fill the application form carefully with educational and personal details.
  4. Upload scanned copies of required documents, photograph, and signature.
  5. Pay the examination fee online and take a printout of the confirmation page.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Bihar STET Online Form 2026 – Extend?

Bihar STET Online Form 2026 – Extend is an official government job recruitment notification. Interested candidates can check eligibility criteria and apply online via direct official links provided above.

How to apply for this vacancy?

Candidates can apply online directly through the official recruitment link in the Important Links table above.
